name: caption_ink
description: Make captions readable over light cards (the graphics covering a caption's band: an opaque overlay, a 3D scene with a backdrop, or an overlay whose pixels cover the band, such as frame_broll's paper matte). Renders the frame without captions at each caption, measures the backdrop in the rows the caption draws in, and writes ink ("dark" over a light card, "light" over a dark one) and inkAuto ({card, ink, backdrop}: what it wrote and the luminance it measured) on the caption, so the editor, sample_frame and the export draw the same. Footage is left to the style. An ink is this step's only while inkAuto names the same ink; any other ink is a person's and never changed. Ink this step wrote is cleared when the card is gone. A caption whose words lie over different cards (or over a card and footage) is split at the word nearest the edge, one caption per run of words, each inked on its own; a person's captions, translated ones and those with translations are never split. Does nothing for plate and subtitle. generate_captions runs it when the project has a card. Writes the captions only; a caption edit since it read them is refused.

input.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

output.description: {dark, light, cleared, kept, split, changed, warnings?}: captions set dark, set light, cleared, and left as a person set them; split is the captions split at a card's edge (their pieces count in dark and light); changed is whether anything was written.

params.name: project
params.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json
